findings.highlight: It just happened to seem like a good idea to me, but Saber said that it was a "risky but certain" choice.
findings.evidenceJa: 偶然に期待するようなものだが、セイバー曰く『危険ではあるが確実』な手なのだそうだ。
findings.governingReading: Patrolling on foot is like hoping for coincidence, although Saber calls the method dangerous but reliable.
findings.explanation: A patrol that amounts to relying on chance becomes an idea that happened to seem good to Shirou.

findings.highlight: Without any extra magical energy from me, it takes all of Saber's power just to exist.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺からの魔力提供がないセイバーは、それこそ日々『ここにいる』だけで精一杯なのだ。
findings.governingReading: Saber receives no magical energy from Shirou and must spend her own reserves merely maintaining existence.
findings.explanation: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.

findings.highlight: "I know you need to save energy, but meals are important, too. I still have some leftovers from lunch, so let me fix you dinner. You can go to bed after that."
findings.evidenceJa: 「魔力の温存は判ったよ。けど人間食事も大切だろ。昼は余りもので済ませちまったから、夕飯はちゃんと食べてくれ。寝るのはその後でいいじゃないか」
findings.governingReading: Because lunch was only leftovers, Shirou urges Saber to eat a proper evening meal before sleeping.
findings.explanation: Shirou's wish to make up for a leftovers lunch becomes an offer based on having leftovers available, changing why he insists on dinner.

findings.highlight: Looking a little displeased, Saber politely takes a seat at the dining table, her posture perfect.
findings.evidenceJa: 不満げにこぼして、セイバーは行儀よくテーブルの前に正座する。
findings.governingReading: She sits seiza in front of the table, a specific floor-seated kneeling position.
findings.explanation: Saber kneeling formally at the table becomes merely sitting with perfect posture.

findings.highlight: I start chopping daikon radishes and throw them into the wok.
findings.evidenceJa: 大根をドッカドカにぶった斬って、ドバーっと鍋に投入する。
findings.governingReading: Shirou chops daikon with comic force and throws it into a 鍋, the pot used for the dish.
findings.explanation: A cooking pot becomes a wok.

findings.highlight: As I expected, Fuji-nee and Sakura take one look at Saber and then fix me with a laser-hot glare.
findings.evidenceJa: 当然と言えば当然、予想通り藤ねえと桜は面食らってこっちをじーーーーーっと見つめてくる。
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee and Sakura are taken aback and stare steadily at Shirou after the lodging announcement.
findings.explanation: A stunned fixed stare becomes a laser-hot glare.

findings.highlight: That's all the explanation I give.
findings.evidenceJa: と説明してからはや十分。
findings.governingReading: It has already been ten minutes since he gave the brief lodging explanation.
findings.explanation: Ten minutes of silence becomes the end of Shirou's explanation.

findings.highlight: They don't even drink the tea to avoid making a sipping sound, leaving the hot tea to go cold.
findings.evidenceJa: お茶を飲もうにも湯飲みの音さえ響きそうで飲めず、熱い緑茶はとっくに冷めきっていた。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot bring himself to drink because even the sound of the teacup seems likely to echo; his hot green tea has gone cold.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to raise his cup becomes everyone refusing to drink.

findings.highlight: "Anyway, she came to see my old man. I can't just send her home. She's just taking the time for a little tourism and won't be staying that long, and we can have her stay in one of the open rooms."
findings.evidenceJa: 「とにかく切嗣を訊ねてきたんだから、帰ってもらうわけにはいかないだろ。観光に来ただけだからそう長くは滞在しないっていうし、離れを使ってもらうから問題ないと思うし」
findings.governingReading: Shirou's cover story says Saber will use the detached building or wing, so lodging poses no problem.
findings.explanation: A detached wing becomes one of the open rooms.

findings.highlight: "Whew. Well, if she knows Kiritsugu, then we'll just have to let her stay. He did mention he had some relatives abroad. Um, Ms. Saber? Looks well-behaved, so I guess I can't say no."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—ふう。まあ、切嗣さんの知り合いなら仕方ないか。外国に親戚がいるとか言ってたし、えっと、セイバーさん？　もしっかりしてるようだし、私は反対できないかな」
findings.governingReading: Taiga says Saber appears しっかりしている—self-possessed, dependable or sensible—so she cannot object.

findings.highlight: "Hm? Oh, yeah. Her name sounds kinda strange, but I guarantee that she's good people. She might act a little weird because she isn't used to Japan yet, but I'd appreciate it if you'd help her out."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ん？　ああ、変わった名前だろ。名前通り無愛想だけど、いいヤツなのは保証する。あんまり日本になれてないんでおかしなところもあるけど、桜が教えてくれると助かる」
findings.governingReading: He calls the name unusual, says she is as blunt or unsociable as the name suggests, but guarantees she is a good person and asks Sakura to teach her Japan.
findings.explanation: Shirou's remark that Saber is unsociable like her name disappears.

findings.highlight: The meal begins with a tuna tataki salad and fried chicken with a mildly spicy scallion sauce. It's followed by a somewhat standard main course of beef and potato stew, accompanied by an assortment of deep-fried tempura featuring fluffy shrimp.
findings.evidenceJa: かつおのたたきサラダ風から始まって、ピリリと辛いねぎソースをかけた鶏肉揚げ、定番といわんばかりの肉じゃがと、トドメとばかりにえび天を筆頭に天ぷら各種を用意する。
findings.governingReading: The first dish is a salad-style preparation of katsuo, skipjack bonito.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. She stopped by the other day.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ。ちょっとした縁で家にあがってもらったんだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou's cover story says a minor connection led him to have Rin come into the house.
findings.explanation: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.

findings.highlight: Whatever fantasies I had of Tohsaka died last night.
findings.evidenceJa: 我が校の誇る優等生は昨夜死んだ。
findings.governingReading: He jokes that the proud model student of their school died last night—in his own mind—and that 'model student Rin Tohsaka' has vanished from him.
findings.explanation: Shirou's admired model-student image becomes romantic fantasy and school-idol fixation.

findings.highlight: "Why was she here? It's a little strange. She has nothing to do with us. Not me, or you, so why?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「どうして、遠坂先輩がここに来るんですか。そんなのおかしいです。だってぜんぜん関係ない。ここにいるのはわたしで、先輩とあの人はぜんぜん関係ないのに、どうして」
findings.governingReading: Sakura insists that Senpai and that person have nothing to do with each other, while she is the one who is here, repeating why in distress.
findings.explanation: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.

findings.highlight: Sakura suddenly goes still, looking downcast.
findings.evidenceJa: 俯いたまま、桜はじっと体を押さえる。
findings.governingReading: With head lowered, Sakura stays still while pressing or holding her body, before the damaged later line elaborates her self-embrace.
findings.explanation: Sakura holding her own body disappears from the intact narration.
